description: This file defines the PdfDocument class, which represents and manages PDF documents within the PDFsharp .NET library. It includes functionalities for creating, opening, modifying, saving, and signing PDF files, as well as handling document-specific settings, properties, and internal structures such as pages, fonts, security, and outlines.

classes.name: DocumentHandle
classes.description: A helper class that manages weak references to the PdfDocument instance, used internally for managing imported or external documents.

methods.name: EnsureNotYetSaved
methods.description: Checks if the document has already been saved and prevents further modifications if so.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the document, saving if created with a filename or stream.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the document to a specified path or stream.

methods.name: SaveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the document to the specified path or stream.

methods.name: SetPdfA
methods.description: Temporary method to mark the document as PDF/A conformant.

methods.name: IsPdfA
methods.description: Indicates whether the document is marked as PDF/A conformant.
